versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Color Palette Advisor.
- Generates professional, accessible color palettes for UI/UX and brand design across mini-program, App, Web, and large-screen platforms.
- Offers detailed HEX palettes (primary, secondary, neutral, semantic, accent), usage guidelines, and accessible contrast ratios.
- Adapts palettes based on user inputs: industry, platform, style, main color, and dark mode needs.
- Provides platform-specific color usage notes and references for industry standards and accessibility.
